title: Where is it?
description:
Write `int indexOf(const std::vector<std::string>& names, std::string_view target)`. It returns the position of the first element equal to `target`, or `-1` if there is none.

This time you need the position, so use an index loop. `names.size()` is an unsigned type (`std::size_t`); use `std::size_t` for the index and convert when you return.
